titel: Why You Should Never Bathe Your Bunny

beats.say: Why should you never give your bunny... a *bath?*
Rudi's bunny got a bit *dirty.* So Rudi runs it a bubble bath!
The bunny panics, so Rudi adds a *rubber duck.* It just kicks water everywhere.
Now it's soaked, so Rudi grabs a *leaf blower.* Meet the dandelion bunny.
Rabbits *clean* themselves, like cats. They almost never need a bath.
In water, rabbits *panic.* They can kick so hard, they break their own spine.
And wet fur takes ages to dry. A damp bunny can get *hypothermia.*
Instead, *brush* your bunny. And if its bum gets dirty, use a damp cloth, and see a vet.
